item.title: ROUNDUP: WAC rival makes undefeated Lathrop work for semifinal ticket
item.description: Lathrop coach Dwayne Davis did not express concern over his undefeated team’s 60-52 win over 11th-seeded Ceres in a Sac-Joaquin Section Division III quarterfinal on Thursday.

item.title: Battle-worn Spartans fall to reigning champs in semifinal
item.description: In the opening moment of Thursday night’s semifinal tilt with visiting No. 4 Liberty Ranch, top-seeded Lathrop fired a bomb that went in and out of the hands of the Hawks goalie, dribbling just outside the upright. The Spartans would only get one more good shot at the net, as defending Sac-Joaquin Section Division IV champion Liberty Ranch escaped the slick field at Bennie Gatto Field with a 3-0 win.

item.title: Lancers charge to 1st section final since ’20
item.description: Yandel Gutierrez is inevitable. The East Union sophomore and national scoring leader came up empty-handed on multiple opportunities in the run of play during the first half of the No. 2-seeded Lancers’ Sac-Joaquin Section Division IV semifinal with visiting Venture Academy on Thursday. item.title: Meeting in Joshua Cowell’s backyard: What elected leaders & city management were up to on Thursday
item.description: What would Joshua Cowell think? On Thursday, four dozen people gathered in what was once Cowell’s backyard where it faded into the proverbial “south 40” of his farm. Cowell, for those unfamiliar with him, is the man who was the ultimate power walker.

item.title: Oakwood Shores, Raymus Village subject of initial annexation talks
item.description: San Joaquin County and Manteca are looking at two potential annexations designed to improve the delivery of services to upwards of 2,000 people.

item.title: Addition street lights being added on dark spots on Yosemite Ave.
item.description: Making the streets of Manteca safer — including several “little projects” — are part of the public works priorities for streets in the fiscal year starting July 1.

item.title: Tidewater Bikeway repaving from Louise Ave. to Lathrop Road is coming later this year
item.description: The Woodward Park splash pad opening. Tidewater Bikeway pavement resurfacing. Three new neighborhood parks on the way and another seven in the planning process.

item.title: Big O Tires returns to East Yosemite Avenue location
item.description: Big O Tires is returning to Manteca to its former location. The tire store is conducting a grand opening on Friday, March 6, with a ribbon cutting at 10 a.m. at 810 East Yosemite.

item.title: Event helps HOPE shelter homeless families
item.description: HOPE Family Shelters is staging a “Bingo Breakfast” event on Saturday, March 7, featuring food and games. The $40 ticket includes a Chick-fil-A breakfast chicken biscuit, side, coffee, swag bag, and six bingo cards.

item.title: MANTECA SNARES $850,000 TO EXPAND ANIMAL SHELTER
item.description: Manteca has secured $850,000 in federal funding to expand the animal shelter.
